suraghornivāsadeśaṃ vaktuṃ tatsaṃnihitaṃ himavacchṛṅgaṃ varṇayati -
uttarasyā ityādinā

bhuvaḥ saṃbhūtaṃ nirgataṃ
karpūrāṇāṃ paṭalaṃ rāśiḥ

śārva hasanaṃ cāndra ātapo veti
pratyekamutprekṣā

athavā diśo medaḥ hasanaṃ cāndra ātapo vā bhuvaḥ bhūmiṃ
prāpya karpūrapaṭalaṃ saṃbhūtamityautprekṣikavaikalpikanānāhetūpapādyā
ekaiva viśiṣṭotprekṣā

śailakuñjareṇa parvataśreṣṭhena himavatā nirmuktasya dhṛtasya
śṛṅgaparamparālakṣaṇasya muktākalāpasya nāyako maṇiriva sthita ityarthaḥ

śailasthakuñjarebhyo nirgalitasya muktākalāpasya nāyakaḥ saṃgrāhako rāśiriveti
vā

yatra yāsu dikṣu saṃcaran bhavati tatra bhṛguṣu prapātasthaleṣu pravartante anyāsu
nivartante

dyotakānāṃ bahūnāmapi
udyantaṃ vā ādityamagniranusamārohati itivatsahaprayogasaṃbhavādvatinokte'pi
sādṛśye ivaśabdaprayogaḥ

kailāsākhyaśṛṅgasya pādāḥ
pratyantaparvatāstadīyānāmaraṇyānāṃ saṃbandhibhi rudrākṣairanyaiśca
tarugulmakaiḥ phalapuṣpakāṣṭhamūlādyupajīvanena nikaṭajīvinaḥ
rājyavibhavairdhanaiśca guhyakanāyako rājarājo dhaneśvaro'pi jitasteneti śeṣaḥ
etena nigraheṇa vinā prajā na vartata eva

yathā tṛṣitanidrāṇasya ciratṛṣṇaṃ manaḥ
ambumahāvarte bhramati tadvat

svāni svīyāni putramitrādīni svaśarīragatānīndriyāṇi cādanyāni ca tattvataḥ kāni
yuktitaḥ kīdṛśāni ceti vicārayetyarthaḥ
srataḥ paramārthavastubhūtasya tava acalaṃ ceto na tolayiṣyanti

vijvaraṃ te manaḥ svaṃ manorūpamutsṛjya bhūtapūrvavapuḥ
pūrvasiddhabrahmasvabhāvaṃ bhūtvā śamaṃ nirvikṣepatāmeṣyati
tarhi kiṃ manasaḥ sattaiva naṅkṣyati netyāha - tiṣṭhadeveti

yathā
pūrvamanorante kalikālaṃ prāpya kalaṅkaiḥ pāpairvikalaṃ bhuvanaṃ
punarmanvantaragatau satyāṃ tiṣṭhadeva kalaṅkaṃ tyajati tadvanmano'pi
jīvanmuktavyavahārakṣamatayā tiṣṭhadeva pūrvatanaṃ manorūpaṃ tyajatītyarthaḥ

na kevalaṃ duḥkhanivṛttireva jñānaphalaṃ kiṃtu niratiśayānandasāmrājyamapi
yatra brahmādayo'pyanukampyā ityāha - anukalpyā iti

tarhi kiyatsu viṣayeṣu kiyatkālaṃ vā vairāgyaṃ kartavyamiti cettatrāha -
tāvaditi

sārvikayā sarvavastubhūtayā buddhyā sarvadā sarvatra deśe sarvaṃ dṛśyaṃ
sarvathā parityajya sarvaḥ pūrṇātmā svātmanaivopalabhyate na
kadācitkutracitkathaṃcitkatipayaviṣayatyāgamātreṇetyarthaḥ

sarvaṃ dṛśyaṃ parityajya yatkiṃcitsarvathā parityaktumaśakyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ
tadeva paraṃ padamityarthaḥ

manaḥ sakalakāraṇakāryaparamparāmaye jagati maṇiṣu sūtramivānugate sanmātre
svakalpanayā vijṛmbhitaṃ sadvyatiriktaṃ sarvaṃ rūpaṃ alaṃ niḥśeṣamapāsya
tatastadanantaraṃ svavapurmanorūpamapi mūlājñānanāśādbādhena parivilāpya
yatsaccinmātraikarasaṃ vastu eti prāpnoti tadeva tadbrahmarūpamityarthaḥ
